title: Backoff for reconnects
subtitle: Suggested for Sync/Reconnect.swift
fallback_text:
Backoff for reconnects (Swift, for Sync/Reconnect.swift):
```swift
func backoff(_ n: Int) -> Double {
  min(5, 0.25 * pow(2, Double(n)))
}
```
Ran in 0.4 s on Studio Mac: 0.25 0.5 1 2 4 5. Reply “apply” to put it in the file.
